search_text: 设 $f(x,y)$ 是连续函数，交换二次积分 $\int_{-a}^0dx\int_{-x}^0f(x,y)dy+\int_0^a dx\int_{x^2}^0f(x,y)dy\ (a>0)$ 的积分次序[\quad] $\int_0^a dy\int_{-\sqrt y}^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^a dy\int_{-y}^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^a dy\int_{-y}^{y}f(x,y)dx$ $\int_0^a dy\int_{-y}^{\sqrt y}f(x,y)dx$ 解答　原式$=\int_0^a dy\int_{-y}^{\sqrt{y}}f(x,y)dx$。
